episodes.title: Who Even Is An Entrepreneur?
episodes.description: Explore what being an entrepreneur means beyond familiar celebrity business founders.

episodes.title: How to Develop a Business Idea
episodes.description: Explore where business ideas come from and how to develop them into the basis of a new venture.

episodes.title: Value Proposition and Customer Segments
episodes.description: Value is the core of any business, and it directs all future decisions, innovations, and customers that get targeted.

episodes.title: What Can You Learn from Your Competition?
episodes.description: Assess business competition and your venture’s competitiveness in markets with more than one possible winner.

episodes.title: Legal Basics and Business Entity Formation
episodes.description: Explore legal considerations involved in moving a business idea toward bank accounts, taxes, and liability.

episodes.title: Minimum Viable Product and Pivoting
episodes.description: Explore how listening to customers and pivoting can help a business adapt when its original idea misses market needs.

episodes.title: Testing Your Product and Getting Feedback
episodes.description: To figure out if an idea is as good as we think it is, we have to talk to our customers.

episodes.title: The Core of a Business – Key Activities & Resources
episodes.description: Explore the different functions and activities needed to keep a business running.

episodes.title: How to Seek Help and Find Key Partners
episodes.description: Identify gaps in your expertise and capacity, then seek people or tools that can help.

episodes.title: How to Build Customer Relationships
episodes.description: Like any committed relationship, the relationship between a business and its customers needs nurturing.

episodes.title: How to Communicate with Customers
episodes.description: No business, no matter how innovative and amazing it is, will survive if people haven’t heard of it.

episodes.title: How to Sell Anything
episodes.description: We can craft a narrative and use well-placed emotional appeals to tell customers a story.

episodes.title: Revenue Streams
episodes.description: Profit, revenue, income, assets, cash flow -- all these words mean money, but they all have specific uses.

episodes.title: Expenses & Costs – How to Spend Money Wisely
episodes.description: Explore business expenses and spending choices that can threaten a company’s ability to keep operating.

episodes.title: Understanding Financial Statements and Accounting
episodes.description: Learn how basic accounting helps track expenses and revenue so a business can understand where its money goes.

episodes.title: Financing Options for Small Businesses
episodes.description: Explore funding needs at different stages of a business, from an early idea to a minimum viable product and beyond.

episodes.title: Is Growth Right For You?
episodes.description: Our options for growth are usually tied to the type of business model we started with.
